summary: The registrant files an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a medical incident affecting Mario J. Gabelli, Trustee, Chairman, and CIO, and the implementation of GAMCO Investors' succession plan. As of March 22, 2026, Christopher J. Marangi was named President of GAMCO, while day-to-day operations continue under co-CEOs Douglas R. Jamieson and Christopher J. Marangi. The Gabelli Value team co-CIOs Kevin V. Dreyer and Christopher J. Marangi lead the portfolio management team during Mr. Gabelli's absence. No deal terms are specified. The filing serves as an abrupt leadership update triggered by an unexpected health event, not a routine meeting notice.
